name: Parent Resident Visa

qualifying_event.description: For parents of an adult New Zealand citizen or resident sponsor, via a two-stage Expression of Interest then invitation-to-apply process, subject to an annual cap.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Adult child sponsor's income/support evidence; family relationship evidence; health, character, and English-language evidence.

requirements.blocker_text: The sponsoring adult child (a NZ citizen or resident) must meet a minimum income threshold -- the exact current figure was not confirmed to tier-1 precision in this pass, only referenced generically as 'sponsorship (including minimum income thresholds)'.
Capped at 2,500 places per year across the Parent Category; selection is via an Expression of Interest pool with invitations issued against the annual cap.
Health, character, English language, and family-relationship requirements must be met and assessed as credible at the EOI stage.

evidence_required.document: Adult child sponsor's income and identity evidence

outcome.duration_length: Resident Visa with travel conditions, convertible to Permanent Resident Visa

sources.title: Immigration New Zealand Operations Manual -- Parent Category residence instructions: two-stage EOI/invitation process, 2,500/year cap, sponsor income threshold, health/character/English/relationship requirements
